rationale: Build entries by run 1-5: succeeded, succeeded, not_declared, not_declared, not_declared. Declared run-command probes: succeeded, failed, succeeded, failed, failed. Nonzero run probes lack required CLI arguments or standard input. They show incomplete invocation rather than a matched application-startup failure; scenario commands demonstrate operation when supplied valid inputs.
limitation: The declared commands were not re-observed with their required subcommands/input. Startup consistency cannot be inferred from these incomplete bare-command probes.

rationale: FR-001: run 2 starts an unsolved predefined puzzle, accepts a swap and reports one action on completion. Run 3 reports the selected Starter puzzle solved immediately with zero actions. The recorded predefined-challenge play behavior differs. Reviewed coverage: 10/17 requirements have an observed status in at least one run; 27/85 requirement-run cells have an observed status. These counts describe coverage, not stability.
limitation: Only the selected default challenges are compared; neither recording establishes a graphical-board implementation. Unobserved branches cannot establish further variation; no causal attribution to SRS omissions is made.
